Name: Seasonal Cute Greenhouse
Author: neuralwiles
Description:
A seasonal greenhouse replacement with ample space for crops and trees.


[size=4][i]Features[/i][/size]

  ♡  Larger greenhouse map with ample space for normal crops, trellis crops, and trees.
  ♡  Dedicated non-tillable iridium sprinkler spots.
  ♡  Forest themed with many trees and flowers.
  ♡  Recolor compatible and changes with the seasons!
